title: UK Critical Third Parties Exposure Mapper
description: Maps material and important business services onto the four UK-designated Critical Third Parties (effective 13 Jul 2026), splits CTP-owed vs firm-retained duties per PRA PS16/24 / FCA PS24/16 Fundamental Rules, and flags provider concentration and indirect chain exposure. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

rows.description: Per-service provider match verdict, substitutability, and RTO

mcp_tool_definition.name: map_uk_ctp_exposure
mcp_tool_definition.description: Maps a firm's material/important business services onto the four UK-designated Critical Third Parties (Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL, Google Cloud EMEA Limited, Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited, Oracle Corporation UK Limited; designated effective 13 Jul 2026 per HM Treasury) via legal-entity-exact matching, flags indirect chain exposure via sub-outsourcing/reseller keyword detection, computes HHI provider concentration, and splits CTP-owed duties (PRA/FCA PS16/24-PS24/16 Fundamental Rules 1-6) from firm-retained duties (SS2/21 outsourcing risk assessment, exit strategy, operational-resilience impact tolerances) which designation does not reduce. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/638-uk-ctp-exposure-mapper.html for interactive use.
